title:
Type used to define access to a specific action or group of actions.
If no permissions apply to a type#action, access is **denied** by default.

Permission string format (4 tokens, colon-delimited):
  `access:typeName:actionGroup:action`
@see access-control.c3doc.md
- `*` matches any value in that token position.
- Permissions are **not recursive**: a permission on a Type does not imply the same on its inner types.
Use `Type.Inner` for a specific inner type or `Type.*` for all inner types.

Examples:
| Permission             | Explanation                                                |
|------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------|
|"allow:*::*"            | allow all actions on all Types (admin)                     |
|"deny:*:write:"         | deny all actions in actionGroup=write on all Types         |
|"allow:User::upsert"    | allow User.upsert()                                        |
|"allow:Type.Inner:*:"   | allow all actions on Type.Inner                            |
|"allow:Type.*:*:"       | allow all actions on all inner types of Type               |

Relationships between roles and permissions:
- Permissions are inherited. A permission granted to a nested role is automatically granted to parent roles of that role.
- The order of permissions in a role does not matter. All permissions are evaluated to determine access.
- Permissions are OR-ed across roles. If a user has multiple roles, access is allowed if any role allows it.
- Permissions are AND-ed within a role. If a role has both allow and deny permissions that apply to a type#action, deny takes precedence.
name: Permission
